answer: A farm far from any root scores near zero, so 141 aliases need 141 walks that reach real roots. Walk results are published and the scoring is deterministic. The ripple is the wall and the ferrous is the gate: Random walks from trusted roots score each identity by its distance to the roots. A farm of 141 aliases must climb the wall 141 times, the prism ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
